name: com.unity.timeline
description: Use Unity Timeline to create cinematic content, game-play sequences, audio sequences, and complex particle effects.

samples.description: This sample project includes a Timeline instance with different custom tracks that demonstrate time dilation, video, text, tweening, and character animation.

This sample project includes a Timeline instance with multiple Track groups, tracks, animated characters, effects, and camera switches that demonstrate how to use Unity's Timeline to create a cut-scene.
